project_title: Agentic Email Organizer — Complete 14-Lab Final Capstone

architecture_overview.paradigm: Multi-Agent Graph Orchestration with Parallel Swarm & Governance

lab_integration_matrix.Lab 2 (Tool-Using Agent): Central ToolRegistry with dynamic execution & latency tracking
lab_integration_matrix.Lab 3 (Skill Creation): Reusable EmailSkills (classify, priority, actions, draft, followups)
lab_integration_matrix.Lab 4 (Memory & Retrieval): SQLite Persistent MemoryStore with semantic/keyword retrieval
lab_integration_matrix.Lab 8 (Parallel Agent Swarm): ThreadPoolExecutor parallel swarm dispatched discipline agents concurrently
lab_integration_matrix.Lab 9 (Deep Research Agent): Synthesized 5 deep research dossiers with citations
lab_integration_matrix.Lab 10 (Cloud Ops & Error Monitoring): Simulated cloud health (Simulated Local Cloud Environment (College Lab Runtime)) with circuit breakers
lab_integration_matrix.Lab 11 (Agentic SDLC Factory): Automated CI/CD test suite passed 7/7 assertions
lab_integration_matrix.Lab 12 (Safety & Governance): Strict human-in-the-loop enforced for 5 drafts (Zero unauthorized sends)
lab_integration_matrix.Lab 13 (Discipline-Specific Agents): Academic, Placement & Admin specialists contributed domain recommendations
lab_integration_matrix.Lab 14 (Integrated Capstone): Unified single-command pipeline running continuously to completion
